//MandatoryQueryFilters: When true, tenant query filters are registered unconditionally and an unresolved tenant
matches nothing (fail closed). When false, the legacy conditional behaviour applies:
no tenant context => no filter registered => queries span every tenant.
Requires the Gateway to propagate X-Aovias-Organization-Id, otherwise internal API-key
routes have no tenant and legitimately return zero rows. See ADR-002 / Wave 2.2B.3.1.
